purpose: A claim feed, not a status source. Third parties have publicly claimed AI-assisted resolutions for these Erdos problems. Recording a claim here NEVER changes a problem's status anywhere in this atlas: status changes when UPSTREAM changes, not when a claim appears. That rule was learned the hard way on #552, where our own new-value claim was retracted, and is applied to #421, where a circulating solution left the upstream record open. The value of this file is triage: it tells an agent where a live claim already exists so effort is not duplicated, and it flags the cases worth verifying.
